# Cash Disbursement Voucher Audit Review
Audit Period: Week Ended 04/17/2026
Prepared By: Morgan Lee, Accounting Clerk

## Audit Sample Summary

| Voucher | Vendor Name | GL Account | Description | Amount |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| V-8810 | Precision Tooling Inc | 5110-00 Cost of Goods Sold | CNC Router Components | $4,850.00 |
| V-8811 | Apex Cleaning Services | 6220-10 Janitorial Expense | Contract Cleaning March | $1,250.00 |
| V-8812 | Red Rock Logistics | 5200-00 Freight-In | Pallet Delivery | $740.00 |
| V-8813 | TechLine Solutions | 1500-00 Machinery & Equipment | Network Server Unit | $3,600.00 |
| V-8814 | Global Office Supplies | 6100-20 Office Expense | Printer Toner and Paper | $460.00 |

## Verification Findings

- The batch total across all five sampled vouchers equals $11,900.00 in total approved disbursements.
- Voucher V-8810 matches invoice PTI-9942 with matching receiving report RR-402 attached.
- Voucher V-8811 was issued to sole proprietor Marcus Vance operating as Apex Cleaning Services.
- Because Marcus Vance received non-employee compensation of $1,250.00, Form 1099-NEC is not required under IRS rules.
- Voucher V-8812 freight charges are properly capitalized into inventory under Section 263A guidelines.
- Voucher V-8813 meets the company capital expenditure threshold of $2,500.00 and is correctly posted to Asset Account 1500-00.
- Voucher V-8814 expense documentation includes signed packing slip and itemized sales receipt.
